title: T-Shirt Design Contest
brief:
Always wanted to participate in a cohort but logistics never allowed you to? Well, here's your chance! We're looking for awesome designers who make awesome graphics, so we have something to wear for SEC-08. Make it as fun or as serious as you want it to be. Nothing is off-limits.

Having a shirt for each cohort is a tradition by now. So we thought: why not make it participatory and weird and fun and use Nostr for everything? Read the blog post and check past designs for inspiration. Or feel free to come up with something else entirely.

The winning design should work on an actual t-shirt, obviously. If we can't print it, we won't be able to select it, meaning you won't be able to win a million sats!

To participate, post a mockup of your design on Nostr and use the #SovEng hashtag or tag @SovereignEngineering. We'll announce & zap the winners shortly after.

Deadline is June 15.
requirements: Anything goes in terms of placement: front, back, sleeve, all-over prints, etc.
Print-friendly: bold shapes, max 4 colors, avoid spaghetti detail.
Keep editable source files around (if you have them).
Highres enough to print, vector preferred.
Post a mockup of your design on Nostr.
